summary: Implemented Lambda (monai/transforms/utility/array.py, appended at end) and Lambdad with LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases (monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py, between ConcatItemsd and the alias block). Changed the typing import to add Callable and added the Lambda import. Tests, flake8, and black were not run, per instructions; line lengths were checked by awk against the 120 limit and the diffs were reviewed by reading.
